description: The modern, all-batteries-included GitHub SDK for Python, including rest api, graphql, webhooks, like octokit!

summary.one_liner: githubkit is a fully typed Python SDK for the GitHub REST and GraphQL APIs, offering both sync and async clients inspired by Octokit.
use_cases: Calling GitHub REST endpoints from Python scripts
Building async GitHub bots or services
Paginating through large lists of GitHub resources
notable: Supports both sync and async calls with full type annotations
REST API versioning including GitHub Enterprise Cloud (GHEC)
Optional Pydantic validation for webhook events and REST responses
Built-in HTTP caching and automatic retry
Lazy loading of APIs and models
caveats: README does not state platform or version limitations
Development setup is described only by reference to a contributing guide
